$comment: Accepted plugins. Nothing here can be installed yet: voidbase has a loader and a manifest format, but pb_plugins does not exist. The official plugins voidbase ships are listed so the marketplace names what exists; submissions are open so the shape of what people want is visible before installing is designed around it.

entries.title: Backups
entries.summary: PocketBase's backups API: create, list, download, upload and restore archives kept in the instance's own R2 bucket.

entries.title: Realtime
entries.summary: Realtime subscriptions over SSE, fanned out by the instance's hub Durable Object, with presence. Provides realtime@1.
